name: Groq API
notes: Perpetual free tier (not a time-limited trial or one-time credits). Limits are published per model, not one universal bucket; you hit whichever cap (RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD) comes first. Limits apply at the organization level, not per user or API key. Cached tokens do not count toward rate limits. Signup at console.groq.com via email/Google with no credit card (card requirement not stated on official page; corroborated by third-party sources — treat as likely but unofficial). Upgrade path is the paid Developer plan for higher limits.
